criteria.title: Traceable source entries
criteria.startingState: A candidate scripture and commentary have been identified.
actions: Inspect the register and its supporting source evidence.
Compare source, edition, links and uncertainty with the evidence.
criteria.expectedResult: Records distinguish works, editions and commentaries; direct links and rights are supported or clearly pending.

criteria.title: Coverage and uncertainty
criteria.startingState: The catalog includes source inventory records and unresolved items.
actions: Compare the register with the source inventories.
Inspect a missing or conflicting source entry.
criteria.expectedResult: Coverage is measurable and missing, duplicate or unverified items remain explicitly unresolved.
